No evidence confirms commit 07d09f1 deployment or startup log content for v8_paper interval.

claim: 'Not yet confirmed: whether this actually reduces the overshoot magnitude on future hard_stop closes — needs more real trades to check.'
observed_ground_truth: Ground truth has no data on hard_stop closes, overshoot magnitude, or trade counts post-tightening; this is consistent with the claim's own admission of insufficient data, and no contradiction is found.
expected_ground_truth: Claim appropriately flags its own uncertainty; ground truth neither confirms nor denies this since no trade-level evidence exists in the audit bundle.
operational_impact: No immediate operational risk since the claim self-identifies as unverified; but it underscores that broader PnL/trade claims in this document are not corroborated by current audit evidence.
